answer: A one-berth intake sits inside a dry canyon, not on the public harbor board. The applicant stakes 13.8 POA and receives one jade token stamped from this epoch seed, valid only at winch 6 above the inner harbor. For four hours they hoist a 6-byte crate tally every 7 minutes while the load stays between 420 and 465 kg. Two clerks recompute the token from the seed and accept only one per winch. Raising 1,900 aliases needs 1,900 unshared tokens and 65,100 hoists. A second hoist on the same winch, a missed interval, or an out-of-band load burns 64% of the stake and locks that winch for 11 epochs.
